First Glenstone Bank – Internal Use Only"},{"spec_id":"spec_0607","text":"Title: Nadia / Lars – sync 🎮
Date/Time: Tuesday, Oct 8, 2:00 – 2:30 PM
Location: Huddle Room "Boss Fight" (3rd floor, east side)

Description:
Hey Lars, grabbing 30 with you before the milestone gate. Want to go deep on a few things re: the Ashfield site build, mostly where your head's at on the vertical slice scope and whether the current perf budget is realistic given what Keiko flagged on the draw-call spikes in the streaming zones. Also want to talk through your ownership on the encounter pipeline going forward, since Fern's rolling off to live-ops next sprint and someone needs to own the tuning loop and the telemetry hooks. No deck, just bring your honest read on velocity and any blockers you haven't surfaced in standup 🙏

If we have time I'd love your take on the crunch-avoidance plan Carmen and I sketched for the content lock, specifically the cut list. Your call on what's P0 vs. nice-to-have matters here.

Random logistics while I have you:
🚗 Garage level B is closed Tues–Wed for resurfacing, use the overflow lot on the north side
🍕 Lunch is catered Thursday for the playtest, Dmitri is collecting dietary restrictions
🎂 Lucia's birthday is Friday, card is at the front desk, sign it!

See you Tuesday 👍
– Nadia
